title: The Optimal Huffman Signal Compression
statement:
You are given the symbol frequencies of N distinct characters in an ancient text.
Construct an optimal prefix code using Huffman's algorithm, and calculate the total number of bits required to encode the entire text.
inputFormat:
First line: Integer N.
Second line: N space-separated positive integers representing character frequencies.
outputFormat: Print the total bit length of the compressed text.

sampleCases.explanation: Huffman tree builds with optimal code lengths yielding 75 total bits.
